01 — The story begins

Some feelings don't need words.They need a song.

Welcome to Nee Naan Naam, an intimate musical storytelling experience that takes you through the beautiful phases of love, brought alive through timeless melodies, heartfelt stories and unforgettable performances.

Because sometimes, one song says everything that words cannot.

Come. Feel the music. Relive your story.

02 — Three chapters of love

You. Me. Us.

The evening moves through three chapters — each one a different shade of the same story.

Nee.

03 — The live experience

An evening that feels like your favourite song.

Warm light, a small stage and a room full of couples. Every element of the night is shaped around one idea — that the music you love sounds different when you hear it together.

04 — The artist

AravindKarneeswaran

The Voice Behind the Emotions.

A passionate singer and performer, Aravind brings music and storytelling together to create memorable experiences. With a love for timeless melodies and contemporary music, he takes audiences on an emotional journey through the many shades of love.

For him, music is more than a performance. It's about connecting hearts, creating memories and making every moment count.
